'''Sister''' was the honorific granted to priestesses of the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]]. [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] was a sister of the circle, until she overthrew the [[High Circle of Elders]] and establish herself as [[All-High Priestess]].<ref name="MSW35" />
